summary: One VivaCity-style camera (counter 324) covers all six zones at Oxford St & York Rd from 2024-11-18, so each counter-direction is its own series and the Oxford St cycleway zones (1501, 1510, 1521, 1524) carry nearly all the bikes. The record is clean apart from partial days at install (2024-11-18), after the 2025-09-27 to 2025-10-01 outage (2025-10-02 morning) and at the end of the download (2026-09-24), plus two bursts of spurious detections in the York Rd S zone (2026-04-16, 2026-08-16/17); the 2026-04-25 midday gap was released as a backlog at 16:00, so that day's total stands. Weekly swings in 2025-09 and mid-2026 track rain and holidays, and the nearby tube at site 163 shows them too; a possible weather-related under-count in eastbound-OUT zone 1521 from late June 2026 is flagged as uncertain.
